scientific.integrity: The open primary equal-area source and the author-uploaded original equal-area paper were materially inspected. Searches covered named, alternating-side, semiregular, and exact-formula aliases. The proof is exact; finite computation is used only as a regression check.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to strictly convex equiangular polygons and does not classify the full equal-area moduli space.
The area formula uses ordinary Euclidean perimeter and is not affine invariant.
An equivalent elementary observation may exist in unindexed expository literature.

title: Euclidean rigidity and exact area stability of equal-area equiangular polygons
